the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: decompose F on U into a filtered colimit of coherent submodules H_i; pull each back through the construct functor (s_*t^*, alpha) and form the fibred product (F, beta) x (s_*t^*H_i, alpha) inside QCoh of the groupoid; exactness of restriction to U (from the proof of lemma-abelian) makes this an intersection diagram, the injective arrow t^*H_i -> s^*F comes from beta by flatness of t, and the push-pull lemma shows each F_i is coherent; since s is qcqs, s_* commutes with filtered colimits, so the identification (F, beta) = colim (F_i, beta_i) follows (source lines 3237-3285)
